source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.11 with Fig. 5.16 (PDF 108-109).

blocks.text: Jaise fluid badalte cross-section aur oonchai ke pipe se guzarta hai, dabao pipe ke saath badalta hai. Bernoulli ki equation fluid dynamics ki bunyadi equation hai jo dabao ko fluid ki speed aur oonchai se jorti hai. Ise akhz karne mein hum farz karte hain ke fluid incompressible, non-viscous hai aur steady-state tareeqe se bahta hai. Waqt t mein pipe se fluid ka bahao lein (Fig. 5.16).

blocks.alt: Pipe baen taraf oonchai par chaure hisse se mur kar daen taraf neeche tang hisse tak jata hai, neeche zameen ki lakeer hai. Baen taraf dabao P1 mass delta m, lambai delta x1 aur raqba A1 ki peeli tukri ko dhakelta hai jo speed v1 se oonchai h1 par hai. Daen taraf usi mass delta m ki narangi tukri, lambi delta x2 aur raqba A2, speed v2 se oonchai h2 par hai, aur dabao P2 use daen se peechhe dhakelta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.16: Ghair-yaksaan cross-section ke pipe mein mukhtalif oonchaiyon par fluid ka ideal bahao (kitab ki Figure 5.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono tukriyon ki mass delta m barabar hai. Tang hisse mein raqba A2 chhota hai, is liye wahi mass lambi tukri (delta x2 > delta x1) mein phailti hai aur speed v2 zyada hoti hai. P1 fluid par kaam karta hai aur P2 us ke khilaf; yahi kaam KE aur PE ki tabdeeli mein jata hai.

Fluid ke oopar ke sire par force P1 A1 hai, jahan P1 dabao aur A1 oopar ke sire par cross-section ka raqba hai. Peechhe ke fluid ka fluid ko faasla delta x1 chalane mein kiya kaam W1 = F1 delta x1 = P1 A1 delta x1. Isi tarah neeche ke sire par fluid par kiya kaam W2 = -F2 delta x2 = -P2 A2 delta x2, jahan P2 dabao, A2 neeche ke sire ke cross-section ka raqba aur delta x2 usi waqt t mein fluid ka chala faasla hai; W2 manfi liya jata hai kyunke yeh kaam fluid ki force ke khilaf hota hai. Kiya kaam W = W1 + W2, ya W = P1 A1 delta x1 - P2 A2 delta x2 ... (5.19). Agar v1 aur v2 oopar aur neeche ke siron par velocities hon to W = P1 A1 v1 t - P2 A2 v2 t. Equation of continuity (Eq. 5.18) se A1 v1 = A2 v2, is liye A1 v1 t = A2 v2 t = V (volume), to W = (P1 - P2) V ... (5.20). Agar m mass aur rho density ho to V = m / rho, to Eq. 5.20 ban jati hai W = (P1 - P2) m / rho ... (5.21).

Is kaam ka ek hissa fluid apni kinetic energy badalne mein aur ek hissa apni gravitational potential energy badalne mein istemal karta hai: KE ki tabdeeli delta KE = (1/2) m v2^2 - (1/2) m v1^2 ... (5.22); PE ki tabdeeli delta PE = m g h2 - m g h1 ... (5.23), jahan h1 aur h2 oopar aur neeche ke siron ki oonchaiyan hain. Fluid ke is volume par energy ke baqa ka qanoon lagane par (P1 - P2) m / rho = (1/2) m v2^2 - (1/2) m v1^2 + m g h2 - m g h1 ... (5.24). Eq. 5.24 ko tarteeb de kar P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 + rho g h1 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 + rho g h2.

blocks.title: Bernoulli ki equation
blocks.text: P + (1/2) rho v^2 + rho g h = mustaqil. Dabao, fi unit volume kinetic energy aur fi unit volume potential energy ka majmooa steady, incompressible, non-viscous bahao ke har nuqte par ek sa hai.

blocks.caption: Derivation qadam ba qadam
rows: W = P1 A1 delta x1 - P2 A2 delta x2 (5.19) = (P1 - P2) V (5.20) = (P1 - P2) m/rho (5.21)
delta KE = (1/2) m v2^2 - (1/2) m v1^2 (5.22); delta PE = m g h2 - m g h1 (5.23)
(P1 - P2) m/rho = delta KE + delta PE (5.24)
P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 + rho g h1 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 + rho g h2

blocks.prompt: Pani nuqte 1 par 200 000 Pa ke tahat ufqi taur par 3 m s^-1 se bahta hai; nozzle par dabao 101 300 Pa hai. Nikalne ki speed nikalein (numerical 5.6). Bernoulli ke mutabiq yaksan pipe mein dabao mustaqil rehna chahiye, phir bhi yeh pipe ke saath girta hai; kyun (constructed response 5.3)?
blocks.explanation: P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 se v2^2 = 9 + 2 (200000 - 101300)/1000 = 206.4, to v2 = 14.4 m s^-1 (print 14.3). Bernoulli non-viscous fluid farz karta hai; real fluid deewaron se viscous raghrat mein energy khota hai, to yaksan pipe mein bhi dabao musalsal girta hai.

items: Siron ke dabao ka kaam W = (P1 - P2) V = (P1 - P2) m/rho delta KE + delta PE mein jata hai (incompressible, non-viscous, steady): P1 + (1/2) rho v1^2 + rho g h1 = P2 + (1/2) rho v2^2 + rho g h2, ya P + (1/2) rho v^2 + rho g h = mustaqil.
